trial_court: Additional District Judge No.1, Barmer in Civil Misc. Case No. 94/2015 (07/2014)
facts_of_case: Petitioner-wife preferred a petition under Section 13 of the Hindu Marriage Act seeking dissolution of marriage against the husband with the averment that she is Paliwal by caste and respondent-husband is by caste Meena.

legal_principles.principle: Custom being in derogation of the general rule is required to be construed strictly.
legal_principles.held: Hon'ble Apex Court held that for custom to have the colour of a rule or law, it is necessary for the party claiming it to plead and thereafter prove that such custom is ancient, certain and reasonable.
cited_cases: Dr. Surajmani Stella Kujur vs. Durga Charan Hansdah & Anr : Appeal (Crl.) No. 186/2001 (SLP (Crl) No. 2436/2000), decided on 14.2.2001

legal_principles.principle: The party relying upon a custom is obliged to establish it by clear and unambiguous evidence.
legal_principles.held: Hon'ble Apex Court held that the party relying upon a custom is obliged to establish it by clear and unambiguous evidence.
cited_cases: Dr. Surajmani Stella Kujur vs. Durga Charan Hansdah & Anr : Appeal (Crl.) No. 186/2001 (SLP (Crl) No. 2436/2000), decided on 14.2.2001

outcome.final_order: The instant revision petition has been filed by husband being aggrieved by the order dated 15.4.2021 passed by the learned Additional District Judge No.1, Barmer in Civil Misc. Case No. 94/2015 (07/2014), whereby application under Section 2(2) of the Hindu Marriage Act read with Order 7 Rule 11 CPC filed by him during proceedings under Section 13 of Hindu Marriage Act was dismissed.
